disambiguation: Not a note-taking method; it is a utility that automatically generates empty lines at the end of the document.
intentEvidence: Infinite Note is an Obsidian plugin that automatically appends newlines to the end of your document.
problem: Users often hit the absolute bottom of the editor when scrolling or typing near the end of a document.
summary: Automatically appends newlines to the end of a document, creating an infinite scroll experience that prevents hitting the editor's bottom boundary.
